assumptions: One already authorized immutable row snapshot and one field: valid inline, valid object/key, missing object key, unknown storage kind or conflicting inline/key. Text and JSON, full and explicit preview reads are distinct finite modes.

A provider read returns its complete body, absence or failure. Empty text is complete; empty or malformed JSON is invalid. Exact object generation, byte hashes, streaming transport correctness and arbitrary JSON schema validation are not proved.

Full reads in six repositories set strict mode for all thirteen offloaded fields. Explicit generation summary APIs retain their preview contract. Container logs, Vertex registry, optional job hydration and phone-message reads are separate protocols.

Real PGlite conformance uses canonical columns, defaults, enums and indexes, with cross-domain foreign keys omitted. Controlled R2 outcomes establish repository behavior, not live provider availability, authorization, source-replacement races, account deletion, retries or cancellation.
bounds.progress: A started read settles only if provider resolution and the validation continuation are weakly fair. An unavailable or malformed field may settle as an error; successful remote availability is not assumed.

assumptions: Weak fairness of finish includes actual provider resolution and subsequent validation; no elapsed deadline or provider success is guaranteed.
